title: Subjective and Normative Language in Service Standards
description: Tests discovery of subjective or unmeasurable normative language ('reasonable response time', 'adequate communication', 'resolved appropriately') lacking objective acceptance criteria.

expectedRequirements.statementPattern: .*Incoming customer support tickets are ingested automatically into the ticketing platform.*
.*Critical severity service interruptions require the incident coordinator to issue customer status updates within 15 minutes.*

expectedFindings.rationale: Service standard contains subjective and unmeasurable normative language ('reasonable response time', 'adequate communication', 'resolved appropriately') without objective metrics, SLA thresholds, or verification criteria.

expectedNonFindings.description: Critical outage communication requirement specifies an objective 15-minute response threshold and does not contain unmeasurable subjective language.
